object_description: three staggered building volumes parallel to the street
design_condition: The staggered volumes are set back and aligned with the topography to preserve visual axes, retain existing trees and villas, and create a flowing sequence of courtyards and open spaces between old and new buildings.

positive.statement: The placement and staggering reduce the spatial impact while establishing a dialogue with the historic buildings.

position.rationale: Staggered masses and varied heights are clearly visible across the top and elevation views.

positive.statement: The spatial expansion creates a well-proportioned sequence of squares that connects lower and upper levels.

position.rationale: Open intervals between volumes read as connected ground-level squares in the top view.

positive.statement: The typological separation of the buildings leads to a clear allocation of functions.

position.rationale: Three distinct connected volumes provide a plausible geometric anchor for separated functions.

positive.statement: Despite the considerable depth of the building, the sectional solution allows all rooms to be adequately naturally lit.

position.rationale: Interior rooms are unsampled; the marker is constrained to an exterior portion of the deep plan.

positive.statement: Separating the public wing from the workshop halls prevents noise and other emissions from spreading into public spaces.

position.rationale: Interior program separation is not distinguishable, so the anchor uses a plausible lateral building zone.

positive.statement: The large spans enable very flexible room design on the upper floors.

position.rationale: Repeated elevated horizontal levels are visible, though structural spans are not individually identifiable.

positive.statement: The construction concepts suggest economical and sustainable execution.

position.rationale: Economy and sustainability describe construction performance without a useful spatial referent.

positive.statement: The project has an architectural expression that is pleasantly appropriate to the task and location.

position.rationale: The whole building composition and stepped profile provide the relevant expression anchor.

negative.statement: The demarcations toward the main street appear too pragmatic and hardly strengthen the desired address.

position.rationale: The building edge facing the front of the sampled footprint anchors the street-facing demarcation.

negative.statement: The proposed steps place an unpleasant strain on the entrance situation and historic courtyard.

position.rationale: Entrance steps and courtyard are not distinct, so the marker uses a plausible ground-level frontage zone.

negative.statement: The design in the western area remains rudimentary, with no design discussion in the historic context.

position.rationale: The western portion of the staggered footprint is directly constrained by the top and west views.

negative.statement: The tree species composition must necessarily be limited to native plants.

position.rationale: Trees are absent from the sampled cloud; the marker estimates a peripheral landscape surface.

negative.statement: The simple fire-protection approach does not meet the regulations in all respects.

position.rationale: Fire compliance is a building-wide system judgment without a specific geometric location.
